name: Proposal Presentation
description: Capture presentation coverage, audience reactions, questions, and follow-up commitments.

sections.title: Storyline and Coverage
sections.instruction: Summarize the presentation storyline, capabilities, evaluation factors, and proof offered.

sections.title: Questions and Answers
sections.instruction: List audience questions and the answers given. Mark unanswered questions.

sections.title: Objections and Feedback
sections.instruction: List objections, feedback, concerns, and observable reactions without inferring sentiment.

sections.title: Commitments
sections.instruction: List commitments made by either side and any written confirmation needed.

sections.title: Content Gaps
sections.instruction: List missing proof, unclear responses, or material to strengthen.

sections.title: Follow-up Actions
sections.instruction: List owners, actions, and dates when stated.
